answer: 2023–24: 2,208 LEAs were surveyed; 1,579 responses were recorded. The report states a response rate of about 72% of all surveyed LEAs, or 87% of the 1,823 LEAs remaining after excluding 385 that did not offer TK. 2024–25: 1,464 LEAs were surveyed; 952 responses were recorded, with a stated response rate of about 65%. The report additionally states that 926 of the remaining LEAs (95%) indicated they had at least one TK program; this is not labeled as a response rate.
